canonical_payload.title: feat(integration): execute domain stages and authenticate native outputs
canonical_payload.body:
The exact-pair input runner now executes six bounded digest-bound local stages and reconciles registered native domain outputs. Thirteen semantic consumers enforce input, dependency receipt, pair/projection, rights/freshness and operational-result bindings. The native reader checks protected-main run identity, archive checksum and final run/artifact/main readback; observations exclude private output bodies.

Validation: 148 regression and negative tests passed, including actual input-stage compatibility, all thirteen output consumers, transport mutations and dependency joins. Primary and independent capability classifiers passed. Existing CI test entrypoint is reused without workflow trigger or permission changes. Rollback: revert this change.

This implements six local stages and thirteen output consumption/authentication paths, not all thirteen native producers. No producer registration, lawful provider acquisition, remote write, native operating proof, promotion, approval or manual dispatch is claimed. Seven native producer adapters and actual lawful current transaction/liquidity input remain missing. Production/Public/G5/provider activation remain HOLD. See docs/integration/RUNTIME_DOMAIN_CONNECTION_EXECUTION_V1.md for each domain and completion boundary.
